text: Pame Stoixima is OPAP's sports-betting brand: the OPAP article records that in 2000 "Pame Stoixima, the first legal sports betting game, was launched in Greece" and that the game "would quickly turn into OPAP's most profitable product".
short: Pame Stoixima is OPAP's first legal sports betting game, launched in Greece in 2000.

source.name: Wikipedia: OPAP (history of the Pame Stoixima game)
source.quote: Pame Stoixima, the first legal sports betting game, was launched in Greece. This game would quickly turn into OPAP's most profitable product.
